digest: Nvidia faces intense scrutiny, leadership turbulence, and calls for a shakeup heading into a major earnings call.
The AI trade and broader tech sector look toward upcoming IPOs like Anthropic amid market uncertainty.
Geopolitical tensions and military conflicts escalate in the Middle East, impacting shipping and regional stability.
US politics and regulatory shifts under a changing Congress continue to influence industries ranging from EVs to Social Security.
Retail investors are navigating personal finance topics, including retirement planning, real estate trends, and workplace benefits.
